summary: All 46 source hashes and sizes matched, and all eight reported computations reproduced. The comparison covers 13,002 of 13,008 registered effects, with 98.25% agreement in direction. Two corrections were needed. The deposited dose labels resolve the paper’s conflicting adjusted-P inequalities in favor of P < 0.05, yielding 2,498 DES12 discoveries. The saved GEO landing page is a CAPTCHA. The family SOFT and count matrix establish cohort membership. The corrected proposal retains the compared closure and passed the repository checker. [Paper](https://doi.org/10.3389/fendo.2023.1140886) · [Author workbooks](https://doi.org/10.6084/m9.figshare.21842124.v1)
openIssues: Maternal litter assignments remain unknown for the ten RNA libraries.
The author workbook omits raw P values, and the exact DESeq2 settings remain unresolved. Of 2,498 author discoveries and 847 registered discoveries, 828 overlap.
